findings.finding: Pi can warn and fall back to built-in models while exiting zero.
findings.fix: Reject model-loading diagnostics and require the exact requested provider/model in the offline listing.

findings.finding: Multiple Pi agents can overwrite a shared job-local model snapshot.
findings.fix: Preserve distinct immutable configuration files and record each model_config_file plus its SHA256.

findings.finding: Failed streams can retain initialized zero usage and appear complete after native retry success.
findings.fix: Diagnose zero-usage failed assistant messages as unknown, keep known subtotals, and mark usage/cost partial.

findings.finding: Concurrent first publication of a shared distribution can fail on rename or staging-name collision.
findings.fix: Use unique staging directories, atomically publish, verify and reuse a concurrent winner, reject corrupt bytes, and clean temporary directories.
